dek: Capture His Heart is a video training program that teaches women attraction techniques for finding a committed partner; Save My Marriage Today is a written home-study course aimed at repairing a marriage in crisis. This comparison covers what each program actually includes, how checkout and guarantees work, and which situation each one fits.
description: Compare Capture His Heart vs Save My Marriage Today: program format, package contents, checkout terms, practical fit, and relationship-safety limits.

faqs.answer: Capture His Heart is aimed at women who are dating and want to attract a committed partner. Save My Marriage Today is aimed at married women whose relationship is in crisis or near separation. They address different relationship stages.
faqs.question: Which program is for dating, and which is for marriage?

faqs.answer: Capture His Heart is an online video training program with worksheets and checklists. Save My Marriage Today is a written home-study course of e-books and lessons with instant download access.
faqs.question: How is each program delivered?

faqs.answer: Both sellers present the core program as a one-time purchase through ClickBank. Save My Marriage Today's order form also offers an optional trial membership, so check that optional boxes are unchecked if you do not want it. Confirm the final order form before paying.
faqs.question: Are there recurring charges to watch for?

faqs.answer: No. Both sellers market strong promises, but no program can control another person's feelings, consent, or decisions. Save My Marriage Today's own materials recommend face-to-face consultation with a registered professional for serious difficulties.
faqs.question: Can either program guarantee he will stay or commit?

verdict: Choose Capture His Heart when you are dating and want a video-based program on attracting a committed partner. Choose Save My Marriage Today when your marriage is in crisis and you want a structured written course on changing your own responses. Pause on both if the appeal depends on guaranteed love or a saved marriage: no program can control another person's feelings, consent, or decisions.
